name: phpstan-rs-vscode
description: Language Server Protocol client for phpstan-rs, a Rust reimplementation of PHPStan's static analysis engine.

phpstan-rs.enable.description: Enable the phpstan-rs language server. Disabling stops the server and clears its diagnostics.

phpstan-rs.configPath.description: Path to a phpstan-rs.toml override, resolved relative to the workspace folder's root if not absolute.

phpstan-rs.serverPath.description: Absolute path to the phpstan-rs binary. Leave unset to search PATH, then fall back to an automatically downloaded and cached binary.

phpstan-rs.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the phpstan-rs language server.

scripts.test:unit: bun run compile && node --test out/extension.test.js out/serverDownload.test.js out/config.test.js out/serverBinary.test.js
